objectives.description: Copy check-task-references.sh's structure and adapt (set -uo pipefail, --quiet, PATH_SCOPE, -e existence check, deploy-root-guard.sh, exit 2 on unknown flag/extra args)
LIB_CANDIDATES two-candidate array, exit 2 naming both paths when neither resolves
scan_tree() via git ls-files, is_exempt_path skip, strip_durable_axis_lines | strip_exempt_regions then rv_grep_blocking/rv_grep_advisory separately, no hard-coded directory list
objectives.note: Content is stripped ONCE per file and reused for both the BLOCKING and ADVISORY pass, per the library's documented Usage order.

objectives.description: TOTAL_BLOCKING / TOTAL_ADVISORY counters, BLOCKING/ADVISORY vocabulary on finding lines (not FAIL/WARN), preserving the ^  {path}:{lineno}: finding shape
Summary block printing both counts unconditionally; exit 0 clean, exit 0 PASSED WITH WARNINGS when advisory-only, exit 1 on any BLOCKING, exit 2 env/usage
Header comment documenting exit codes, two-tier contract, usage forms, REPO_ROOT override, and source-of-truth pointer
No task-number references in the file

verification_notes.line_count: 202 lines (hypothesis: 180-200; slightly over, attributable to the added ADVISORY pass and its own counter/reporting loop, a known and accounted-for second-tier surface the sibling does not carry)
verification_notes.dirty_fixture_smoke_test: REPO_ROOT=$(pwd) against a committed-then-removed single-file fixture containing '## The widget convention (v2)' reports 'BLOCKING: ## The widget convention (v2)' and exits 1
verification_notes.clean_fixture_smoke_test: same invocation against a version-language-free fixture reports 0 BLOCKING, 0 ADVISORY and exits 0
verification_notes.skip_behavior: a nonexistent PATH_SCOPE prints '[SKIP] ... does not exist' and exits 0
verification_notes.quiet_mode: --quiet suppresses per-finding lines, Summary/FAIL lines still print
verification_notes.repo_wide_smoke_run: Ran via the bounded-wait idiom (Bash tool timeout 600000, inner timeout 540) against this repo with no PATH_SCOPE. IMPORTANT DEPLOY-STALENESS FINDING: with this repo's own stale deployed .claude/scripts/lib/record-version-patterns.sh in place, LIB_CANDIDATES (which prefers the deployed copy, matching the sibling's own convention) picked up the STALE library even under REPO_ROOT=$(pwd), reporting 240 BLOCKING (matching the OLD pre-Phase-2 library's behavior) instead of the correct 5. Verified the SCRIPT's own logic is correct by temporarily moving the stale deployed library aside, re-running (got exactly 5 BLOCKING matching the independent corpus probe: the 2 numbered-ruling-idiom lines plus the 3 Himalaya docs), and restoring the original deployed file byte-identical (diff -q confirmed). Recorded as an issue; no permanent action taken on the deployed tree per the dispatch's explicit instruction not to force a workaround -- the next cycle's redeploy checkpoint resolves this for every consumer of the deployed library, not just this script.
